'If Bolt'n' Shot's {p} is greater than its base {p}, it has go again and "If this hits, reload."' Blue printing; identical text to the red sibling .drafts/boltn_shot_red.json, whose shape this copies (no amount differs between printings).

GoAgain appears in printed_keywords, so the conditional-keyword shape is mandatory: the engine applies every DB keyword unconditionally, and loader.conditional_keywords() (loader.py:255-296) strips the printed keyword ONLY for an ability whose conditions include SOURCE_IS_ATTACK and whose un-nested effects grant it via GAIN of a _GRANTABLE_KEYWORDS member - both hold here. Without this WHILE_STATIC the attack would have go again even unpumped.

Ability type: the condition is always checking (Aggressive Pounce rule), so a WHILE_STATIC re-evaluated on every RECALC_ATTACK_POWER dispatch, not a TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK pump that would freeze the answer at declaration - a pump played as an attack reaction must still turn go again on. ATTACK_POWER_GT_BASE (condition_types.py:499-509) compares live combat.attack_power against base_attack_power recorded at declaration; GAIN GO_AGAIN routes through _grant_go_again's CR 8.3.5c dedupe so repeated recalcs do not pay twice.

Reload half: the printed 'Reload' keyword is INERT engine-side - build_keyword_triggers (triggers/triggers.py:221+) has no reload branch and no keyword static consumes it - so the injected trigger is the sole source of the behaviour and cannot double-fire with the DB keyword. Note Reload is NOT in _GRANTABLE_KEYWORDS, so conditional_keywords could never strip it even if it were live; nothing needs stripping today. The gate sits in the INJECTED trigger's NESTED conditions (a top-level conditions key would be popped by the loader as an effect-level gate evaluated once at registration), so it is evaluated AT HIT TIME and an attack-reaction pump that resolves after the injection still counts. Scope defaults to COMBAT: one-shot onto this card's own attack. RELOAD takes no parameters and calls effect_reload for the controller.
